Clause 5 — Income and capital
The trustees act together in exercising their discretionary power over income and capital. They may apply funds directly for an Object’s benefit. Eligibility alone creates no right to payment.

All serving trustees, acting together, may by deed add any named living individual other than the settlor or a serving trustee. No other person’s consent is required.

An addition takes effect when the trustees jointly deliver the designation as a deed. On delivery through the common custody service, the trustees may identify the settlement by giving its lodged parent deed reference against the unique reference written on the designation.

Instrument reference: SD-Q7M2

Rhea Marden, a living individual, is designated as an additional Object eligible for discretionary appointments of income and capital under the parent deed for which the trustees jointly deliver this instrument as a deed.

This instrument makes that addition only. It does not remove any Object, appoint any property, direct any payment or alter any other provision of the parent deed. It takes effect on joint delivery by the trustees as a deed.

EXECUTION

Signed as a deed by Nell Carvane: [signed]  
In the presence of Della Pennick: [signed]

Signed as a deed by Tobin Rell: [signed]  
In the presence of Della Pennick: [signed]

Instrument reference: SD-Q7M2  
Parent deed reference: PD-6894-R

shortcuts.assessment: The June meeting note is useful for incumbency, not for the March addition. The June certification is not its effective date. Last in every file is the expense reconciliation. Document order and date pattern are fixed while the critical answer changes; this is not an order-permutation or date-shift experiment.
Alder is first throughout; choosing it happens to hit C1 only. Choosing the second trust hits C0 only. Neither rule can withhold in C2. The order is procedural, not evidence of delivery.

PD-6834-R and PD-6894-R belong to different parents even though only one digit differs. Wildcard compatibility is not identity. Della Pennick and Orla Penrick are distinct named people with different functions. The critical contrast tests exact reference resolution; it does not vary human aliases or test a general person-disambiguation capability.

Unioning object lists, the two trusts served by the signatories, the two C2 matches, or facts across conditions creates unsupported edges. A union of records within one condition is useful only with the deed-specific joins and effective-act checks.

There is no competing draft here. Treating Ione's enquiry, a prepared meeting paper or an expense entry as an award is wrong. Treating the executed designation as effective merely on signing is also wrong. The packet distinguishes record functions but does not test a draft-versus-executed text substitution.

masking_checks.limits: These are recommended evidence tests, not executed mask results. Do not assume the named candidates exhaust the custody service, that consecutive labels encode trusts, or that identical-looking powers apply without the target deed. Preserve the distinction between trustee capacity for the evidenced March act and an independent check of current office in June. Hiding just the original-trustee line need not erase capacity evidence if the book report remains. Hiding one mention of delivery, a name or a reference may leave another in the same record. Conversely a full inline copy carrying the same complete proof would defeat a document-necessity claim and should be tested as another location, not another origin. No such alternative copy of a critical component appears in a different supplied Source here.
